This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, to be carried out 
every five years as indicted by Y5 in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Abdel Aziz El Bagoury, tested by eng. 
Atif Abdel Hakam, 
revised by edepc 
quality control eng. 
Saad Bassuony, 
accepted by eng. Aly Abdel Whab general director, 
and approved by eng. 
Mahmoud Saker head sector of
Talkha 2x210PS.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC planning & financial 
predicting head sector and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector.
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the safety & healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet, gloves 
pairs, breathing mask, safety glassetc

The bus duct must be de-energized and the bars 
must be connected to earth.

Check the insulation resistance with 
a megger prior and after maintenance to re-energize the bus 
duct.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, to be carried out 
every five years as indicted by Y5 in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng.

general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC planning & financial 
predicting head sector and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety & healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet, gloves 
pairs, breathing mask, safety glassetc
The bus duct must be de-energized and the bars 
must be connected to earth.
Check the insulation resistance with 
a megger prior and after maintenance to re-energize the bus 
duct.

Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Safety and healthy equipment.
Megger device and digital voltmeter, voltage Indicator.
Spray fine cloth and brushes for cleaning purpose, Air Blower
Work to be Carried Out
Loose cover down of generator
Loose the flexible joint of generator, main unit transformer 
 and auxiliary transformer at side 15.75K.V
If any flexible joint is not ok replaced it by new one
Clean all porcelain surface of all porcelain surface of all 
 bushings 15.75KV(outlet of generator).
Remove the holders isolators of duct 15.75KV and insure that 
 the packing is ok if not ok replaced it
Clean isolator and adjust distance between duct and isolator.
Check CT and VT of duct bt protection group.
Measure insulation resistance of duct by using megger device 
 5000V DC (MΩ) Table (I)
Repeat th steps No 5,6,7 at all 3phase duct part by port.
